a
4∫02πcos⁡t3sin2⁡t+1dt
b
16∫02πsin⁡t3sin2⁡t+1dt
c
8∫02πsin⁡tsin2⁡t+3dt
d

e
16∫02πcos⁡t3sin2⁡t+1dt
